critical_code_review_comments: SEXIER tiles are inside a collapsible accordion (`Wlads SEXIER-Analyse`) that is initially collapsed — that is fine UX-wise but note that tiles are only rendered visible after user clicks. Any automated Playwright test must expand the accordion first before asserting tile visibility.

TTS response is JSON `{audio_url:'data:audio/mpeg;base64,...',cached,persona,voice_id,bytes}` — audio_url is a data URL, not a direct binary. Frontend must decode this. Working as designed.
